svg.title: DealTrace: implemented core and future product surroundings
svg.desc: The transaction control runtime is implemented. Enterprise identity, secure custody, other payment rails and finance operations are future work, not implemented.

g.text: The runtime works. The enterprise shell is future work.
Organization / RBAC · Agent registry · Approval workflows · Enterprise kill switch
Messages → Deal + provenance → bilateral commit → mandate → escrow → verified outcome
Scoped control memory · Audit receipts · Durable transactions · Buyer recovery
HSM signer · x402 · stablecoin · bank rails
Current settlement: testnet escrow + trusted off-chain controller.
No production custody, verified business identity, AP2 / A2A / ERC-8183 compatibility, or customer demand is claimed.
